home.favoritesEmptyBody: Pin a folder while browsing (the star at the top) and it shows up here, reachable from wherever you are.

onboarding.title: Your files, from any network
onboarding.body: Hoard opens the shared folders of your computers and NAS boxes over SMB, at home or away through Tailscale.
onboarding.step1Body: Give it every address it answers on: its local IP, its Tailscale IP or name.
onboarding.step2Body: It tries them all and uses the one that works right now, and checks it is really your machine before sending the password.
onboarding.step3Body: Open files, pin favorite folders and copy files to the phone in the background.

machines.title: Machines
machines.description: Computers and NAS boxes you browse over SMB.
machines.emptyBody: Add a machine once with every address it answers on: local network, Tailscale or a host name.

form.name: Name
form.addressesHint: Hoard tries them in this order and uses the first that answers. Local addresses go first, then Tailscale, then the rest; drag to change.
form.signInHint: The password is stored encrypted on this device (Android Keystore) and never shown again.
form.passwordSaved: A password is saved for this machine.

errors.name: Give the machine a name.
errors.passwordForUser: Enter the password again to change the user name or domain.
errors.host: This is not a valid address.
errors.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.duplicate: This address is already in the list.

discover.title: Found on this network
discover.hint: Tap one to fill in its name and address.
discover.searching: Looking for SMB servers on this network…

test.title: Test connection
test.hint: Tries every address now and signs in. It uses the password you typed, which is then kept on this device.
test.otherServer: Another server answers here (different identity): Hoard will not use it

identity.title: Server identity
identity.body: On the first connection Hoard remembers the server's ID, so a different computer that happens to use the same address on another network never receives your password.
identity.pinsOnConnect: Pinned automatically on the next connection
identity.repinBody: Do this only if you reinstalled or replaced this machine's server. Hoard will trust whatever server answers first on these addresses and pin it again.
identity.repinDone: Identity cleared. It is pinned again on the next connection.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its saved password, favorites and transfer history are removed from this phone. Files on the machine are not touched.

problem.STORAGE_PERMISSION: No access to the phone's files

UNREACHABLE.title: Can't reach this machine
UNREACHABLE.body: None of its addresses answered. Check that it is on and that this phone is on the same network or on Tailscale.

TIMEOUT.title: The machine is not answering
TIMEOUT.body: Every address timed out. It may be asleep, or the network is slow; you can raise the timeout in Settings.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Wrong user name or password
AUTH_FAILED.body: The machine answered but did not accept the saved credentials.

GUID_MISMATCH.title: This is not your machine
GUID_MISMATCH.body: A different server answers on these addresses (you may be on someone else's network). Hoard did not send your password. If you replaced this machine's server, re-pin it in the machine settings.

ACCESS_DENIED.title: No access
ACCESS_DENIED.body: This account may not open this share or folder.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.body: It was moved, renamed or deleted.

ALREADY_EXISTS.title: That name is taken
ALREADY_EXISTS.body: Something with this name already exists here.

NO_SPACE.title: Not enough space on the phone
NO_SPACE.body: Free some space and try again.

NO_APP.title: No app can open this file

TOO_LARGE.title: File too large
TOO_LARGE.body: It is bigger than the built-in viewer loads.

CONFLICT.title: Changed on the server
CONFLICT.body: Someone saved this file after you opened it.

STORAGE_PERMISSION.title: No access to this phone's files
STORAGE_PERMISSION.body: Allow all files access to browse it.

UNAVAILABLE.title: The drive is not available
UNAVAILABLE.body: It was unplugged or ejected. Connect it again and retry.

browse.noSharesBody: This account cannot see any shared folder on this machine.
browse.noMatchesBody: Nothing in this folder matches the search or filter.
browse.onlyHidden: This folder only has hidden files. Turn on “Show hidden files” to see them.
browse.nameInvalid: Names can't be empty or contain \ / : * ? " < > |
browse.nameTaken: Something with this name already exists here.
browse.deleteBody: It is deleted on the machine, not moved to a recycle bin.
browse.deleteFolderBody_one: The folder and everything inside it are deleted on the machine. This can't be undone.
browse.deleteFolderBody_other: These {{count}} folders and everything inside them are deleted on the machine. This can't be undone.

openError.NO_APP: No app on this phone can open this kind of file
openError.ACCESS_DENIED: You don't have access to this file
openError.NO_SPACE: Not enough space to open it
openError.GUID_MISMATCH: Another server answered on this address
openError.STORAGE_PERMISSION: Allow all files access to open it

browse.openShareByNameBody: For a shared folder this machine does not list. Hoard remembers it here once it opens.
browse.shareNameInvalid: Enter a share name without \ or /.
browse.shareNotFound: This machine has no share by that name, or does not let this account open it.

download.foldersSkipped_one: {{count}} folder is skipped (folders can't be downloaded yet).
download.foldersSkipped_other: {{count}} folders are skipped (folders can't be downloaded yet).
download.onlyFolders: Folders can't be downloaded yet. Open the folder and select its files.
download.noFolders: No folder chosen yet. Hoard asks Android once for each folder it may write to.

conflict.overwriteHint: Replaces the existing file once the new copy is complete.
conflict.askHint: Shows one question, with “apply to all”.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.description: Copies and moves between your phone, drives and machines.
transfers.emptyBody: Files you copy, move, upload or download show up here with their progress. They keep going with the screen off.
transfers.retryingHint: Connection lost. Retrying, then trying the next address…
transfers.conflicts_one: {{count}} file already exists at the destination
transfers.conflicts_other: {{count}} files already exist at the destination
transfers.someFailed_one: {{count}} file failed; the rest were copied
transfers.someFailed_other: {{count}} files failed; the rest were copied
transfers.detailsGone: The details of this transfer are no longer available.
transfers.interrupted: Interrupted when Hoard was stopped. Retry continues where it left off.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showHiddenHint: Files and folders starting with a dot or marked hidden on the server.
settings.foldersFirst: Folders are always listed before files.
settings.probeTimeoutHint: How long Hoard waits for each address to answer. Raise it on slow networks.
settings.destinationsHint: Android gave Hoard access to these folders. Release one to revoke it.
settings.aboutBody: Hoard is free and open source software, licensed under the GNU AGPL 3.0 or later.
settings.developerHint: The browser build talks to a simulated SMB network. These switches exist only here.
settings.networkHint: Away: local addresses stop answering, Tailscale still works. Watch the routes switch.
settings.worstCaseHint: Adds 18 machines with very long, unicode and one-letter names, a folder with 5,000 entries, a 1.4 TB file and a transfer that fails mid-way.
settings.storageGranted: Allowed: Hoard can browse the phone, USB drives and SD cards.
settings.storageDenied: Off: only your machines and drives you pick one by one.
settings.volumesHint: Plug in or pull out the mock USB drive and SD card; the home screen and notices follow live.
settings.mockShareHint: Pretends another app shared three photos and a PDF: the Save to… screen opens.
settings.cullingHint: Assisted culling: what counts as blurry or eyes closed, and how bursts are grouped.

text.savedAsUtf8: Saved as UTF-8: {{encoding}} cannot hold some of the new characters
text.tooLargeBody: This file is {{size}}; the viewer opens files up to {{limit}}. Load the first part read-only, or open it with another app.
text.notTextBody: It holds binary data. Open it with another app instead.
text.csvTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} rows. Switch to Source for the rest.
text.mermaidError: This diagram could not be drawn
text.conflictBody: Someone saved it after you opened it (on {{date}}). Choose which version to keep.
text.deletedBody: It was deleted or moved after you opened it. Save your text again, or as a copy.
text.unsavedBody: Your changes are not saved yet.
text.unsavedLeaveBody: You are leaving the file with changes that are not saved yet.

access.shareReadOnlyAnonymous: This share is read-only for this account.
access.folderReadOnlyAnonymous: This folder is read-only for this account.
access.fileReadOnly: Read-only: {{user}} can open this file but not change it on the server.
access.fileReadOnlyAnonymous: Read-only: this account can open this file but not change it on the server.
access.localFolderReadOnly: Android does not let apps change this folder.
access.localFileReadOnly: Read-only: this file is on a read-only drive or folder.

locations.connectHint: Plug in a USB drive or an SD card reader and it shows up here.
locations.accessCardTitle: Allow access to this phone's files
locations.accessCardBody: Needed to browse the internal storage, USB drives and SD cards. Machines work without it.

permission.title: Hoard can't see this phone's files yet
permission.body: Allow all files access to browse the internal storage. Your machines keep working without it.
permission.volumeBody: Allow all files access, or give Hoard a folder on this drive (DCIM, for example) through Android's folder picker. Android does not let apps pick a whole drive.
permission.picker: Choose a folder on this drive

unavailable.title: {{name}} is not available
unavailable.body: It was unplugged or ejected, or Android is still checking it. Connect it again and retry.

restricted.title: Android keeps this folder private
restricted.body: Since Android 11, Android/data and Android/obb belong to each app. No file manager can open them, even with all files access.

storageAccess.title: Let Hoard browse this phone
storageAccess.body: Hoard is a file manager: besides your computers, it opens the phone's own storage, USB drives and SD cards. Android calls this "All files access".
storageAccess.point1Body: DCIM, Download, Documents and every other folder, with thumbnails, search and the text editor.
storageAccess.point2Body: Plug in a camera card reader or a USB stick and open it right away.
storageAccess.point3Body: Hoard reads or changes files only when you tap. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
storageAccess.step2: Turn on "Allow access to manage all files" for Hoard.
storageAccess.step3: Come back with the back button.
storageAccess.stepRuntime: Tap Allow storage access and accept Android's question.
storageAccess.smbNote: Without it, your SMB machines work as before; USB drives can still be opened one at a time through Android's folder picker.
storageAccess.grantedBody: Hoard can browse this phone's storage, USB drives and SD cards.

transfer.noSubfolders: No folders here. Pick this one, or create one.
transfer.readOnlyHere: Hoard can't write in this folder.
transfer.intoItself: A folder can't go into itself.
transfer.sameFolder: These are already in this folder.
transfer.shareFoldersOnly: Folders can't be shared. Select files.

clipboard.label: Clipboard
clipboard.hint: Open any folder, on any location, and tap Paste here.
clipboard.openFolder: Open a folder to paste here

conflictDialog.title: “{{name}}” already exists
conflictDialog.applyAll_one: Do the same for the other {{count}} file
conflictDialog.applyAll_other: Do the same for the other {{count}} files

save.title: Save to Hoard
save.description: Files another app shared. Save them to this phone, a drive or a machine.
save.emptyBody: Share files to Hoard from any app's share menu and they show up here.
save.textOnly: Only text was shared. Hoard saves files, not text.
save.rejectedHint: Hoard only takes files another app shares from its own storage, not file paths or Hoard's own files.
save.allRejected_one: The shared item could not be received: Hoard only takes files another app shares from its own storage.
save.allRejected_other: None of the {{count}} shared items could be received: Hoard only takes files another app shares from its own storage.

cull.title: Cull
cull.emptyBody: This folder has no RAW, JPEG or HEIF files to cull.
cull.noMatchBody: Change the filter to see the other shots.
cull.saveFailed: Could not save that decision. Try again.
cull.autoAdvance: Move to the next shot after a pick or reject

viewer.title: Viewing {{name}}
viewer.imageFailed: This shot could not be shown.

compare.title: Compare
compare.focusHelp: Focus score (sharpest area). Compare shots of the same burst; higher is sharper.
compare.sharpnessHelp: Sharpness of the subject (a face, else the sharpest area), 0 to 100. The crown marks the better frame: sharper, eyes open, well exposed.

copy.title: Copy picks
copy.destinationHelp: Any folder on this phone, a USB drive, an SD card or a machine.
copy.fallbackRaw_one: {{count}} pick has no RAW: its JPEG is copied instead.
copy.fallbackRaw_other: {{count}} picks have no RAW: their JPEGs are copied instead.
copy.fallbackJpeg_one: {{count}} pick has no JPEG: its RAW is copied instead.
copy.fallbackJpeg_other: {{count}} picks have no JPEG: their RAWs are copied instead.
copy.xmpHint: A small .xmp file with the stars next to each copied shot, at the destination only, for Lightroom, darktable and other editors.

delete.body_one: {{shots}} shots, {{files}} file ({{size}}) {{where}}. A RAW + JPEG pair deletes both files.
delete.body_other: {{shots}} shots, {{files}} files ({{size}}) {{where}}. A RAW + JPEG pair deletes both files.
delete.permanent: This is permanent: there is no trash to restore them from.
delete.partial_one: {{count}} shot was deleted before it stopped.
delete.partial_other: {{count}} shots were deleted before it stopped.

assist.suggestHint: The best frame of each burst, and shots with a problem. Nothing changes until you accept.
assist.suggestPartial: Still analysing: more suggestions will appear. Nothing changes until you accept.

reason.allFlagged: every frame of this burst has a problem

assist.expand_one: Show the {{count}} frame of this burst
assist.expand_other: Show the {{count}} frames of this burst
assist.settingsHint: How Hoard flags shots and groups bursts. Flags and suggestions never decide for you.
assist.blurHint: Higher flags slightly soft shots too; lower only clearly blurred ones.
assist.eyesHint: Higher also flags half-closed eyes. Only faces big enough to matter count.
assist.burstGapHint: Shots taken closer than this start a burst (a new scene splits it). Near-identical frames up to four times further apart join it.
